reviews.summary: Analyzed Bad.java (Java). Detected 2 syntax/runtime issue(s). Runtime: O(n), Space: O(1).

complexity.explanation: Single iterative loop processes each element of the input in linear O(n) time. Operates in-place utilizing only constant O(1) auxiliary variables and pointers.
complexity.bottleneck: Sequential linear iteration over input collection
complexity.suggestedApproach: Single-pass traversal is optimal for unindexed collections.

complexityAnalysis.timeExplanation: Single iterative loop processes each element of the input in linear O(n) time. Operates in-place utilizing only constant O(1) auxiliary variables and pointers.

issues.title: Runtime Error: Potential Division by Zero
issues.description: Arithmetic division divides directly by literal zero.
issues.whyItMatters: Triggers fatal arithmetic exceptions at runtime.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a denominator guard check before dividing.

issues.title: Logical Bug: Unbounded Infinite Loop
issues.description: Loop condition evaluates to true statically without a break clause.
issues.whyItMatters: Causes CPU thread lock and application freeze.
issues.suggestedFix: Add explicit exit criteria or break statement.

issues.title: Code Refactoring Advice
issues.description: Address flagged syntax or runtime exceptions to ensure robust execution.

recommendations: Consider early termination (break/return) once the target condition is satisfied.
Implement defensive validation guards for all input parameters.
Add comprehensive unit test coverage covering boundary and edge cases.
